bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent single-image set. The lead clearly teaches illustrated spread, page turn pacing, warm character, large friendly type, retains its identity at card scale, and shows no visible anti-cue, integrity failure, or confusing overlap with neighboring styles. The independently approved lead is assets/refs/kids-picture-book/reference-01.jpg. No support image is needed because the lead carries the direction without filler.
